notes.title: v0.72.6 - Addressing the Free Look Clunkiness
notes.content:
[h2]We hear you loud and clear! Why do the Free Look controls feel so unresponsive???[/h2]

In this patch we are greatly improving the turn speed at low speeds when using Free Look. This control scheme is still being improved over time, and this is the first of those improvements. 

[b]If it still feels bad, tell us why![/b]

[b]Adjustments[/b]

[list]
[*] Turn rate at slow speeds using Free Look controls is greatly enhanced, to better resemble a modern 3rd person control scheme
[/list]

notes.title: v0.72.5 - Dash Talent Buffs & Minor Stat Balancing
notes.content:
[b]Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed various map collision issues
[/list]

[b]Adjustments[/b]

[list]
[*] 'D-Style Sacrifice' talent dash amplification has been boosted 4x
[*] 'Triple P-Dash SP Master' has been changed to 'Perfect Dash SP Master' which gives you 10% of your Style Points bar per Perfect Dash
[*] Strength combo amplifiers have been buffed
[*] Max Booster sprint speed (Speed stat effect) upper and lower range has been widened
[*] Sprint Speed (Speed stat effect) received a minor reduction at the top end to accommodate for the widened Max Booster sprint speed adjustment
[*] Skill animation speed (Technique stat effect) on the low end has been boosted
[*] Grind speed (Agility stat effect) upper end has been reduced
[/list]

notes.title: v0.72.2 - Visuals, Stability & Gameplay Update!
notes.content:
[b]New Features[/b]

[list]
[*] Prototype Talents available to test (Free)
[*] Dash dial
[*] Perfect Dash
[*] Style Points popup text
[*] Lobby stats allocation (Patreon only)
[*] Player SFX now network synchronised
[*] Improved UI loading notifications
[*] Added Australia server
[*] Momo now has a Magical Princess outfit
[*] Characters now have additional animations in the menus
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed false race starts
[*] Fixed an issue where rooms would desync and break
[*] Fixed an issue where the settings UI would unintentionally try to translate based on the user's OS region
[*] Fixed an issue where players could try joining full or closed rooms which broke the networking and in some cases soft locked the game
[*] Fixed an issue where spamming the Create Room button breaks the networking and in some cases soft locked the game
[*] Fixed an issue where a high FPS could cause the parkour animation to lose the correct rotation
[*] Fixed the crash on start-up on some older machines
[*] Fixed an issue where the login fields would lose focus if you pressed left or right
[*] Fixed issues with Kookee and Momo's hair becoming glitched
[*] Fixed audio slider issues not working properly from hotfix v0.72.1
[*] Fixed various areas where the camera would clip through the environment
[/list]

[b]Adjustments[/b]

[list]
[*] Environment lighting overhaul
[*] Character visuals overhaul
[*] Sprint VFX overhaul
[*] Water visuals overhaul
[*] Improved the performance of equipment physics
[*] Maps now use occlusion culling and LODs to improve overall performance
[*] Memory usage is now handled dynamically which keeps RAM usage stable on start-up
[*] Training room visual update
[*] Spring & Boost Pad visual update
[*] Animation transitions have been smoothed
[*] Updated UI SFX and VFX
[*] A notification sound will now play if the host changes the room settings and you are forced to 'Unready'
[/list]

[b]Known Issues[/b]

[list]
[*] Steam invites are currently not working
[*] If the host leaves during a race, the end game standings will show everybody twice as retired
[*] If a player fails to send the correct position during a race they will show up as first and their race marker may go off the end of the race progress UI (The end game standings are unaffected)
[*] Lobby Loadout sliders may not show the character's current stats correctly, the actual stats are unaffected until the Save button is pressed
[/list]

notes.title: Officially on Steam
notes.content:
It's official. We're now on Steam. How exciting! So go and smash that wishlist if you're as excited as we are. Every bit of exposure helps and we're now at that stage where we need your support.

Please take the time to spread the news about our upcoming play test with friends, streamers, and anyone that may happen to find that spark of interest in FreeJack; it's this type of community engagement that we need to drive this project into full-blown execution.

Reminder that the next open beta will be exclusively on Steam, servers will go live November 18, 2023, at 00:00 UTC, so clear your calendars for that!

It goes without saying that we couldn't have made it this far in the game without your interest in our work. It's our greatest pleasure to once again have the experience of playing alongside each and every one of you at the open beta play test.

See you on the racing grounds.

Best Regards,
- Team FreeJack
